name: Charlene Duchâteau
original_name: シャルレーヌ・デュシャトール
source:
She is the princess of the kingdom of Duchâteau, which thrives on commerce and trade.

She is a beautiful girl with a style so attractive that everyone turns to look at her. Because of this, she is also active as an advertisement for the nation.

On the other hand, she is proud and has a selfish side due to her spoiled upbringing. Compared to Aries and Mireia, who are close friends, she has a younger personality.

Because of this, the public believes that any man who becomes her future husband will have to endure a great deal of hardship. Despite her difficult personality, Aries and Mireia, who are her rare friends, and her family, including the king, call her by the nickname “Char."

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/sanbiki.html#character]official site[/url]]
